name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Rapid pace of interceptor and precision-guided weapons use worries Trump admin.
changes.summary: The U.S. defense industrial base isn't equipped to produce missiles rapidly enough to replenish munitions used in the war with Iran, or transferred for use to Central Command.

changes.title: A Fallen Soldier’s Angst, Love and Longing to Return Home From the Iran War
changes.summary: Sgt. Michael Emmanuel Swinton was killed in recent days, one of 18 U.S. soldiers who have lost their lives since the beginning of the war in Iran.

changes.title: Number of U.S. Troop Deaths in Iran War Appears Lower on Pentagon Website
changes.summary: Three military officials and a Pentagon spokesman gave conflicting explanations for why the number of Americans killed in the Iran war had changed.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: U.S.-Iran strikes escalate, affecting global energy markets, Trump imposes double-digit tariffs on dozens of countries, Vigil held in Madison, Wisconsin, for man killed by police.

changes.title: Brent Crude Oil Prices Top $100 as Conflict With Iran Drags On
changes.summary: Stocks in Asia were down following a sell-off in the U.S. markets over soaring oil prices, rising borrowing costs and worries about the technology industry.

changes.title: Iran War and Trump’s Tariffs Threaten a Resilient U.S. Economy
changes.summary: As renewed fighting with Iran sends oil and gas prices soaring, President Trump has imposed new global tariffs that could push up prices further.

changes.title: ‘We’re Trapped in Hell’: Iranians Say Life Is Put On Hold by Months of War
changes.summary: Devastated by cycles of violence and economic crisis, many are giving up on work and their futures as the United States batters Iran again.

changes.title: Brent Crude Oil Prices Top $100 as Conflict With Iran Drags On
changes.summary: Stocks in Asia were down following a sell-off in the U.S. markets over soaring oil prices, rising borrowing costs and worries about the technology industry.

changes.title: Even as War Rages, Investors Bet Oil Will Be Cheaper in a Few Months
changes.summary: Futures contracts reflect an expectation that low inventories and midterm elections are likely to push the Trump administration to try to ease tensions with Iran.

changes.title: For a 2nd time, House approves resolution to end the war in Iran in a rebuke to Trump
changes.summary: Four Republicans joined Democrats to approve the measure. And while it is not legally binding, the resolution represents growing frustration inside Congress over the war. (Image credit: J. Scott Applewhite).
